name: webllm-adblocker-extension
description: AI-Powered Visual & Heuristic Ad Blocker Chromium Extension using CLIP Zero-Shot Classification & Offscreen WASM

scripts.build: parcel build src/manifest.json --config @parcel/config-webextension --no-source-maps && npm run build:offscreen && npm run build:runtime && npm run copy-wasm
scripts.build:edge-android: node scripts/edge-android.mjs build-manifest && parcel build src/offscreen.html --dist-dir dist-edge-android --no-source-maps --no-content-hash && parcel build src/content.js src/inject.ts src/report-bridge.js --dist-dir dist-edge-android/runtime --no-source-maps --no-content-hash && node scripts/copy-wasm.js dist-edge-android
scripts.build:runtime: parcel build src/content.js src/inject.ts src/report-bridge.js --dist-dir dist/runtime --no-source-maps --no-content-hash
